critical_code_review_comments: routes_import.py:197-216 _reconcile_claim_notes uses substring 'claim' in label.lower() AND rejects any of ('cost','avg','average','per ','rate','amount','$') — correctly protects 'Avg Per Claim'/'Cost per Claim' from override. Note: labels like 'Total Charge Claims' (contains 'charge' — not in exclude list) would be treated as a claim count. Edge case is unlikely with real Medicare CSVs but flagging for awareness. Also, digit-strip via re.sub(r'[^0-9]','',value) will treat '1,943' and '1943' as equal (good) and '1943 (approx)' also as 1943 — safe.

routes_import.py:264-266 assignee_name is fetched only when distribute=='person' AND assignee_id is truthy; execute later checks the same before applying. Safe. If assignee_id points to a deleted user, assignee_name stays None and routing_reason becomes 'Assigned on import to <uuid>' — cosmetic but harmless.

routes_users.py:107-123 list_users now open to any authenticated user (was previously admin-only). Roles filter accepts CSV. Verified. Consider adding a soft limit (currently to_list(500)) and paginating if the org ever exceeds 500 users.
routes_crm.py:221-248 LeadPatch — state uppercased in-place on PATCH. Good. Note: LeadPatch does NOT include account_manager_id/lead_manager_id (those go through /assign) which is intentional.

ImportWizard.js:74-75 doValidate blocks with toast when distribute==='person' && !assigneeId — matches PRD. On line 78, assignee_id is null-forwarded only when distribute==='person', preventing accidental person-assign after switching back to route/equal (good).

LeadDetail.js:294 ld-assign-am select is disabled unless isManager — role gating correct. Assignees list is fetched with roles=account_manager,lead_manager,admin,super_admin, matching backend contract.
